11 BACK EXERCISES
RANKED FOR YOUR
NEXT PULL DAY
Find the right rows for your routine.

Useful for rear delts and upper-back accessory work.
Use a weight you can pull without leaning back.

Change your body angle to make these harder.
Adding weight takes more planning than on a machine.

Your lower back has to hold your torso in position.
Row the dumbbells without swinging your body.

Chest support limits how much you can swing.
The setup needs enough room below the bench.
